slide_title: Same Equation for Linear Regression and Classification

bullets: y = w1 x1 + w2 x2 + w2 x2 + ... + wd xd + b
Model Parameters : w1 , w2 , w3 , ... wd , b
b   is called   "bias"  term as it is independent of  x
y = w1 x1 + w2 x2 + w2 x2 + ... + wd xd + b
y > 0 ⇒  Class 1    y < 0 ⇒  Class 2    y = 0 ⇒  Undefined
Model Parameters : w1 , w2 , w3 , ... wd , b
equations: X = column vector (x_1, x_2, x_3, ..., x_d)
W = column vector (W_1, W_2, W_3, ..., W_d)
y > 0 ⇒ Class 1;  y < 0 ⇒ Class 2;  y = 0 ⇒ Undefined

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title large and bold; 'Same Equation' is blue and underlined, remainder dark red. Section banners are white bold text on dark blue. 'Model' headers are red italic. Equations use color-coded variables: y blue, weights green, x terms red, bias b green. 'Model Parameters' label in blue italic. Slide number in small yellow circle.

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#F2F2F2) and draw a thin dark-red border around the entire slide edge. 2. Add title at top center: 'Same Equation' in blue (#0000CC), bold, underlined, followed by ' for Linear Regression and Classification' in dark red (#8B0000), bold. 3. Add yellow circle (#FFFF99) with dark outline at top-right containing '14'. 4. Top-left: white box with thin border; inside, red italic 'Model', then 'I/P:' in black with red row vector '( x1  x2  x3  .....  xn )', then 'O/P:' with red '( y )'. 5. Left-middle: dark blue (#0000CC) banner with white bold text 'General Case - Regression'. 6. Below it, pale yellow (#FFFFCC) box with thin blue border: red italic 'Model'; equation 'y = w1 x1 + w2 x2 + w2 x2 + ... + wd xd + b' with y blue, w's green, x's red, b green; line 'Model Parameters : w1 , w2 , w3 , ... wd , b' with blue italic label and green parameters; line 'b  is called  "bias"  term as it is independent of  x' with b green bold and x red. 7. Left-bottom: dark blue banner 'General Case - Classification'; below it pale yellow box: red italic 'Model'; same color-coded equation; line 'y > 0 ⇒ Class 1   y < 0 ⇒ Class 2   y = 0 ⇒ Undefined' with inequalities color-coded (y>0, y<0 red; y=0 green; Class 1, Class 2, Undefined blue); 'Model Parameters : w1 , w2 , w3 , ... wd , b' as before. 8. Right-middle: white box with thin border; inside place red italic 'Input:' then red underlined 'X =' and a tall parenthesized column vector (x1, x2, x3, ..., ..., xd) in red; then blue underlined 'W =' with tall parenthesized column vector (W1, W2, W3, ..., ..., Wd) in blue; then bold black 'Output:' with red '( y )'. 9. Use sans-serif font (e.g., Arial) throughout, matching sizes: title largest, banners medium-bold, body text smaller.
